description: Get told when new records matching your filters appear in a dataset API (e.g. new recalls for a brand, new outages in a county). Checks after every refresh of the source; charged one call price per delivery (up to 50 new records), from the key's free calls or credit. Without webhook_url, deliveries wait in an inbox: read them with check_alerts.

api_key.description: Key from get_api_key for this API.

params.description: Filters, same as query parameters, e.g. {"state":"CA"}.

webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL to receive signed POSTs.

name: create_alert
title: Watch for new records
